      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-codex-bridge

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) bundle that lets the agent read the local **Codex CLI** quota and delegate hard tasks to `codex exec` with a model and reasoning effort that fit the current ChatGPT-plan budget.

It is a host-only DSH plugin: two tools, no browser half, no build step, and no npm dependencies.

> Unofficial community plugin. Not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI, Codex, or DeepSeek.

## What it adds

| Tool | What it does | Codex usage |
|---|---|---|
| `codex_status` | Reads the 5-hour and weekly ChatGPT-plan windows, reset times, credits, the model ladder, and the quota-aware recommendation. | none |
| `codex_delegate` | Runs one non-interactive `codex exec` task in a chosen directory and returns the answer, token usage, thread id, and the quota left afterwards. | yes |

`codex_status` talks to `codex app-server` (`account/rateLimits/read`, `model/list`). `codex_delegate` is the only path that spends model usage.

## Quota policy

The deployment default is intentionally narrow:

- **Default:** `gpt-6.1-sol` at reasoning effort **`high`**.
- **Reserve:** when either window has **10% or less left**, auto switches to `gpt-5.6-sol` at `medium`.
- **`gpt-6-astra`:** never selected automatically. An explicit `model: "gpt-6-astra"` is refused unless the caller also sets `allow_expensive_model: true`, because it consumes the shared quota much faster.
- **Floors:** the model never goes below `gpt-5.6-sol`; reasoning effort never goes below `medium`.
- **Blocked:** at 95% used, or when the backend disallows ordinary usage, runs are refused unless `allow_low_quota: true`.

Recommendation table (`model=auto`, `reasoning_effort=auto`):

| Complexity | Normal (both windows > 10% left) | Reserve (either window ≤ 10% left) |
|---|---|---|
| `simple` | `gpt-6.1-sol` / `high` | `gpt-5.6-sol` / `medium` |
| `standard` | `gpt-6.1-sol` / `high` | `gpt-5.6-sol` / `medium` |
| `hard` | `gpt-6.1-sol` / `high` | `gpt-5.6-sol` / `medium` |
| `critical` | `gpt-6.1-sol` / `high` | `gpt-5.6-sol` / `high` |

Explicit choices are validated, never silently downgraded. A refusal names the selectable models or the missing opt-in.

### About `gpt-6.1-sol`

The installed Codex CLI build may not list `gpt-6.1-sol` in `model/list` even though the backend accepts it (a real `codex exec` run confirmed this during development). `codex_status` therefore shows it as a **configured** model and warns that `codex exec` may print a missing-model-metadata warning. Change `defaultModel` / `minModel` in the config if your Codex account uses different ids.

## Install

In the DSH Web GUI, open **Plugins**, add the package directory or install the bundle through the plugin manager:

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "/path/to/dsh-codex-bridge" }
```

From GitHub (once the repository is published):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AK-blank/dsh-codex-bridge#v1.1.1
```

From a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-codex-bridge
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A2 codex-bridge
```

Then restart `dsh web` if the host process already cached an older module. Host-side plugin code is cached per process; a new bundle row activates live, but edits to `lib/*.js` need a restart.

Requirements: DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` (the tested release), Node.js 20+, and a signed-in Codex CLI (`codex login`).

## Configuration

Override the row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: codex-bridge
  name: dsh-codex-bridge
  config:
    minModel: gpt-5.6-sol
    defaultModel: gpt-6.1-sol
    expensiveModel: gpt-6-astra
    minEffort: medium
    defaultEffort: high
    reservePercent: 10
    stopPercent: 95
    statusCacheSeconds: 30
    defaultSandbox: read-only
    ephemeral: true
    maxTimeoutSeconds: 1800
    maxOutputChars: 16000
    codexCommand: codex
    codexHome: ''
```

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `minModel` | `gpt-5.6-sol` | model floor and reserve fallback |
| `defaultModel` | `gpt-6.1-sol` | normal default (may be configured even when not listed by the CLI) |
| `expensiveModel` | `gpt-6-astra` | explicit opt-in only |
| `minEffort` | `medium` | lowest reasoning level ever used |
| `defaultEffort` | `high` | reasoning level for ordinary and hard work |
| `reservePercent` | `10` | fall back when either window has this much or less left |
| `stopPercent` | `95` | block ordinary runs at this used percentage |
| `statusCacheSeconds` | `30` | quota snapshot cache |
| `defaultSandbox` | `read-only` | Codex sandbox unless the caller overrides it |
| `ephemeral` | `true` | do not persist each delegation under `~/.codex/sessions` |
| `maxTimeoutSeconds` | `1800` | hard wall-clock limit per delegation |
| `maxOutputChars` | `16000` | answer characters returned to the model |
| `codexCommand` | `codex` | executable name or absolute path |
| `codexHome` | empty | empty inherits the host environment |

## Usage

Ask the agent:

> Check the Codex quota, then delegate this hard problem to Codex with the right model and effort.

The agent calls `codex_status`, picks a complexity (or passes explicit `model` / `reasoning_effort`), then calls `codex_delegate`. The task must be self-contained: Codex cannot see the DSH conversation, so include absolute paths, symptoms, constraints, and the exact deliverable.

Default sandbox is `read-only`. Pass `sandbox: "workspace-write"` and a `cwd` only when Codex must edit files.

## Verification

```bash
node selftest.mjs             # offline: package contract, policy, rendering, registration
node selftest.mjs --live      # also read the real quota and model ladder (no model usage)
node selftest.mjs --live-exec # also run one tiny codex exec task (spends a little usage)
```

The offline suite covers the quota tiers, the 10% reserve switch, the astra guard, the model/effort floors, blocked-quota refusal, rendering, and the bundle/registration contract. Live checks verify the real `codex app-server` response and the configured ladder. The repository's GitHub Actions workflow runs the offline suite on every push.

## Limitations

- The app-server methods belong to the installed Codex CLI version; an incompatible upgrade fails with `CODEX_RPC` / `CODEX_PROTOCOL` instead of inventing data.
- Codex does not share this conversation's context.
- Default `read-only` means Codex can read `cwd` but cannot write; `workspace-write` keeps writes under `cwd` and still follows Codex's own sandbox/network policy.
- The returned quota is a percentage snapshot, not an exact token reservation; the tiers are spend guardrails.
- `gpt-6.1-sol` availability and model metadata depend on the Codex CLI build and account; configure other ids if needed.

## Community listing

`docs/awesome-entry.yml` is the prepared entry for the community directory [`awesome-dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) (category `usage`). That directory requires the repository to be at least one day old before a PR is accepted, so the PR is intentionally not opened on publish day. The repository also carries the `dsh-plugin` topic for automatic indexes.

        clearTimeout(timer);
        timer = null;
      }
      try {
        rl?.close();
      } catch {
        // Already closed.
      }
      if (child !== null) {
        closeStream(child.stdin);
        killTree(child, 'SIGTERM');
        const force = setTimeout(() => killTree(child, 'SIGKILL'), 1500);
        force.unref?.();
      }
    };

    const finish = (value) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      cleanup();
      resolve(value);
    };

    const send = (message) => {
      if (child === null || child.stdin?.destroyed === true) return;
      try {
        child.stdin.write(`${JSON.stringify(message)}\n`);
      } catch {
        // The server exited between the check and the write.
      }
    };

    const buildStatus = () => {
      if (results.rate === null || results.models === null) return;
      const quota = readQuota(results.rate, now());
      const catalog = normalizeModels(results.models?.data);
      const models = buildModelLadder(catalog, cfg);
      const budget = computeBudget(quota, cfg);
      const recommendation = recommend(models, budget, cfg);
      const windows = {};
      for (const [key, value] of [['fiveHour', quota.fiveHour], ['weekly', quota.weekly]]) {
        if (value === null) continue;
        const window = {
          usedPercent: value.usedPercent,
          remainingPercent: value.remainingPercent,
        };
        if (value.windowMinutes !== null) window.windowMinutes = value.windowMinutes;
        if (value.resetsAt !== null) {
          window.resetsAt = new Date(value.resetsAt * 1000).toISOString();
          window.resetsAtUnix = value.resetsAt;
          window.resetsInSeconds = value.resetsInSeconds;
        }
        windows[key] = window;
      }
      const budgetValue = { level: budget.level, reasons: budget.reasons };
      if (budget.fiveHourUsed !== null) budgetValue.fiveHourUsed = budget.fiveHourUsed;
      if (budget.weeklyUsed !== null) budgetValue.weeklyUsed = budget.weeklyUsed;
      const credits = quota.credits === null ? null : {
        hasCredits: quota.credits.hasCredits,
        unlimited: quota.credits.unlimited,
        ...(quota.credits.balance === null ? {} : { balance: quota.credits.balance }),
      };
      const resetCredits = quota.resetCredits === null ? null : {
        availableCount: quota.resetCredits.availableCount,
        items: quota.resetCredits.items.map((item) => ({
          title: item.title,
          ...(item.expiresAt === null ? {} : { expiresAt: item.expiresAt }),
        })),
      };
      const status = {
        ok: true,
        checkedAt: new Date(now()).toISOString(),
        planType: quota.planType
          ?? (typeof results.account?.account?.planType === 'string' ? results.account.account.planType : null),
        accountType: typeof results.account?.account?.type === 'string' ? results.account.account.type : null,
        ordinaryUsageAllowed: quota.ordinaryUsageAllowed,
        windows,
        credits,
        resetCredits,
        models,
        budget: budgetValue,
        recommendation,
        policy: policyView(cfg, models),
      };
      // Drop null fields: the output schema and the model-facing text only need
      // what the backend actually reported.
      for (const key of ['planType', 'accountType', 'ordinaryUsageAllowed', 'credits', 'resetCredits']) {
        if (status[key] === null) delete status[key];
      }
      finish(status);
    };

    try {
      child = spawn(cfg.codexCommand, ['app-server'], {
        stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
        env: buildEnv(cfg),
        detached: process.platform !== 'win32',
      });
    } catch (error) {
      finish(failure('CODEX_SPAWN_FAILED', `could not start ${cfg.codexCommand} app-server: ${error.message}`));
      return;
    }

    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      finish(failure('CODEX_TIMEOUT', `codex app-server did not answer within ${Math.round(timeoutMs / 1000)}s`, { stderrTail: tail(stderr) }));
    }, timeoutMs);
    timer.unref?.();

    child.on('error', (error) => {
      if (error?.code === 'ENOENT') {
        finish(failure('CODEX_NOT_FOUND', `Codex CLI not found (${cfg.codexCommand}). Install Codex or set codexCommand in the plugin config.`));
        return;
      }
      finish(failure('CODEX_SPAWN_FAILED', `could not start ${cfg.codexCommand} app-server: ${error.message}`));
    });
    child.on('close', (code, signal) => {
      if (settled) return;
      finish(failure('CODEX_EXIT', `codex app-server exited before answering (code ${String(code)}${signal ? `, signal ${signal}` : ''})`, {
        stderrTail: tail(stderr),
      }));
    });
    child.stderr.on('data', (chunk) => {
      stderr = tail(stderr + chunk.toString('utf8'));
    });

    rl = createInterface({ input: child.stdout });
    rl.on('line', (line) => {
      if (settled || line.trim() === '') return;
      let message;
      try {
        message = JSON.parse(line);
      } catch {
        return;
      }
      if (message === null || typeof message !== 'object') return;
      // Server-initiated request: answer with method-not-found so the server
      // never waits on this short-lived client.
      if (message.id !== undefined && typeof message.method === 'string') {
        send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: message.id, error: { code: -32601, message: 'unsupported by dsh-codex-bridge' } });
        return;
      }
      if (message.id === 1) {
        if (message.error !== undefined) {
          finish(failure('CODEX_PROTOCOL', `initialize failed: ${message.error.message ?? JSON.stringify(message.error)}`));
          return;
        }
        send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'initialized', params: {} });
        send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 10, method: 'account/rateLimits/read', params: {} });
        send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 11, method: 'account/read', params: {} });
        send({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 12, method: 'model/list', params: {} });
        return;
      }
      const kind = message.id === 10 ? 'rate' : message.id === 11 ? 'account' : message.id === 12 ? 'models' : null;
      if (kind === null) return;
      if (message.error !== undefined) {
        const text = message.error.message ?? JSON.stringify(message.error);
        if (kind === 'account') return; // optional; planType also comes from rate limits
        const lower = text.toLowerCase();
        if (lower.includes('auth') || lower.includes('login') || lower.includes('unauthorized')) {
          finish(failure('CODEX_AUTH', `Codex is not signed in: ${text}. Run \`codex login\` first.`, { stderrTail: tail(stderr) }));
          return;
        }
        finish(failure('CODEX_RPC', `codex app-server rejected ${kind === 'rate' ? 'account/rateLimits/read' : 'model/list'}: ${text}`, {
          stderrTail: tail(stderr),
        }));
        return;
      }
      results[kind] = message.result ?? null;
      pending.delete(kind);
      if (pending.size === 0) buildStatus();
    });

    send({
      jsonrpc: '2.0',
      id: 1,
      method: 'initialize',
      params: {
        clientInfo: { name: 'dsh-codex-bridge', title: 'DSH Codex Bridge', version: '1.0.0' },
      },
    });
  });
}

function parseUsage(raw) {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined || typeof raw !== 'object') return null;
  const number = (value) => (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0);
  return {
    inputTokens: number(raw.input_tokens),
    cachedInputTokens: number(raw.cached_input_tokens),
    outputTokens: number(raw.output_tokens),
    reasoningOutputTokens: number(raw.reasoning_output_tokens),
  };
}

/**
 * Run one non-interactive Codex task.
 *
 * @param {ReturnType<import('./policy.js').resolveConfig>} cfg
 * @param {{
 *   task: string,
 *   model: string,
 *   effort: string,
 *   cwd: string,
 *   sandbox: string,
 *   timeoutMs: number,
 *   maxOutputChars: number,
 *   signal?: AbortSignal,
 * }} options
 * @returns {Promise<Record<string, unknown>>}
 */
export function runCodex(cfg, options) {
  const {
    task,
    model,
    effort,
    cwd,
    sandbox,
    timeoutMs,
    maxOutputChars,
    signal,
  } = options;
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    let settled = false;
    let child = null;
    let timedOut = false;
    let aborted = false;
    let turnFailed = false;
    let threadId = null;
    let answer = '';
    let usage = null;
    let commandCount = 0;
    let fileChangeCount = 0;
    const errors = [];
    let stderr = '';
    let stdoutBuffer = '';
    let timer = null;
    let forceTimer = null;
    let rl = null;
    const outputFile = path.join(os.tmpdir(), `dsh-codex-${randomUUID()}.txt`);
    const startedAt = Date.now();

    const onAbort = () => {
      if (settled || aborted) return;
      aborted = true;
      killTree(child, 'SIGTERM');
      forceTimer = setTimeout(() => killTree(child, 'SIGKILL'), 2500);
      forceTimer.unref?.();
    };

    const cleanup = () => {
      if (timer !== null) clearTimeout(timer);
      if (forceTimer !== null) clearTimeout(forceTimer);
      timer = null;
      forceTimer = null;
      signal?.removeEventListener?.('abort', onAbort);
      try {
        rl?.close();
      } catch {
        // Already closed.
      }
      try {
        fs.rmSync(outputFile, { force: true });
      } catch {
        // Best effort.
      }
    };

    const finish = (exitCode, closeSignal, spawnError) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      if (stdoutBuffer.trim() !== '') consumeEvent(stdoutBuffer.trim());
      stdoutBuffer = '';
      if (answer === '') {
        try {
          if (fs.existsSync(outputFile)) {
            const fromFile = fs.readFileSync(outputFile, 'utf8').trim();
            if (fromFile !== '') answer = fromFile;
          }
        } catch {
          // The message stream is the primary channel.
        }
      }
      cleanup();
      const answerChars = answer.length;
      const truncated = answerChars > maxOutputChars;
      const answerOut = truncated
        ? `${answer.slice(0, maxOutputChars)}\n\n[truncated: ${answerChars - maxOutputChars} more characters]`
        : answer;
      if (spawnError !== undefined) {
        errors.push(spawnError.message);
      }
      const ok = spawnError === undefined && !timedOut && !aborted && exitCode === 0 && !turnFailed;
      let code = null;
      if (!ok) {
        const blob = `${errors.join('\n')}\n${stderr}`.toLowerCase();
        if (spawnError?.code === 'ENOENT') code = 'CODEX_NOT_FOUND';
        else if (timedOut) code = 'CODEX_TIMEOUT';
        else if (aborted) code = 'CODEX_ABORTED';
        else if (blob.includes('usage limit') || blob.includes('rate limit') || blob.includes('quota')) code = 'CODEX_QUOTA';
        else if (blob.includes('not logged in') || blob.includes('login') || blob.includes('unauthorized')) code = 'CODEX_AUTH';
        else code = 'CODEX_FAILED';
      }
      resolve({
        ok,
        code,
        exitCode: typeof exitCode === 'number' ? exitCode : null,
        signal: closeSignal ?? null,
        timedOut,
        aborted,
        durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
        threadId,
        answer: answerOut,
        answerChars,
        truncated,
        usage,
        commandCount,
        fileChangeCount,
        errors: errors.slice(0, 5),
        stderrTail: tail(stderr),
        model,
        effort,
        cwd,
        sandbox,
      });
    };

    try {
      const args = [
        'exec',
        '--json',
        '--skip-git-repo-check',
        '--color',
        'never',
        '-s',
        sandbox,
        '-C',
        cwd,
        '-m',
        model,
        '-c',
        `model_reasoning_effort=${JSON.stringify(effort)}`,
        '--output-last-message',
        outputFile,
      ];
      if (cfg.ephemeral) args.push('--ephemeral');
      args.push('-');
      child = spawn(cfg.codexCommand, args, {
        cwd,
        env: buildEnv(cfg),
        stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
        detached: process.platform !== 'win32',
      });
    } catch (error) {
      finish(null, null, error);
      return;
    }

    child.on('error', (error) => {
      if (!settled) finish(null, null, error);
    });
    child.on('close', (exitCode, closeSignal) => {
      finish(exitCode, closeSignal);
    });
    child.stdin.on('error', () => {
      // The process can exit before consuming the whole prompt.
    });
    child.stderr.on('data', (chunk) => {
      stderr = tail(stderr + chunk.toString('utf8'));
    });
    child.stdout.on('data', (chunk) => {
      stdoutBuffer += chunk.toString('utf8');
      let newline = stdoutBuffer.indexOf('\n');
      while (newline >= 0) {
        const line = stdoutBuffer.slice(0, newline).trim();
        stdoutBuffer = stdoutBuffer.slice(newline + 1);
        if (line !== '') consumeEvent(line);
        newline = stdoutBuffer.indexOf('\n');
      }
    });

    function consumeEvent(line) {
      let event;
      try {
        event = JSON.parse(line);
      } catch {
        return;
      }
      if (event === null || typeof event !== 'object') return;
      if (event.type === 'thread.started' && typeof event.thread_id === 'string') {
        threadId = event.thread_id;
        return;
      }
      if (event.type === 'turn.completed') {
        usage = parseUsage(event.usage);
        return;
      }
      if (event.type === 'turn.failed') {
        turnFailed = true;
        const message = event.error?.message ?? event.message ?? 'turn failed';
        errors.push(String(message));
        return;
      }
      if (event.type === 'error') {
        const message = event.message ?? event.error?.message ?? 'error event';
        errors.push(String(message));
        return;
      }
      if (event.type !== 'item.completed' || event.item === null || typeof event.item !== 'object') return;
      const item = event.item;
      if ((item.type === 'agent_message' || item.type === 'assistant_message') && typeof item.text === 'string') {
        answer = item.text;
        return;
      }
      if (item.type === 'command_execution') {
        commandCount += 1;
        return;
      }
      if (item.type === 'file_change') {
        fileChangeCount += 1;
        return;
      }
      if (item.type === 'error' && typeof item.message === 'string') {
        errors.push(item.message);
      }
    }

    const seconds = Math.max(5, Math.min(cfg.maxTimeoutSeconds, timeoutMs));
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      timedOut = true;
      killTree(child, 'SIGTERM');
      forceTimer = setTimeout(() => killTree(child, 'SIGKILL'), 2500);
      forceTimer.unref?.();
    }, seconds * 1000);
    timer.unref?.();

    if (signal !== undefined) {
      if (signal.aborted) onAbort();
      else signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    }

    try {
      child.stdin.write(task);
      child.stdin.end();
    } catch {
      // The spawn error path reports the failure.
    }
  });
}

/** Human-readable duration from seconds. */
export function formatSpan(seconds) {
  if (typeof seconds !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0) return 'unknown';
  const total = Math.round(seconds);
  const days = Math.floor(total / 86400);
  const hours = Math.floor((total % 86400) / 3600);
  const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
  if (days > 0) return `${days}d ${hours}h`;
  if (hours > 0) return `${hours}h ${minutes}m`;
  if (minutes > 0) return `${minutes}m ${Math.floor(total % 60)}s`;
  return `${total}s`;
}

/** Human-readable duration from milliseconds. */
export function formatDuration(ms) {
  if (typeof ms !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(ms)) return 'unknown';
  return formatSpan(ms / 1000);
}

function localTime(iso) {
  const date = new Date(iso);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? iso : date.toLocaleString();
}

function windowLine(label, window) {
  if (window === undefined || window === null) return `${label}: unavailable`;
  const parts = [`${window.usedPercent}% used`, `${window.remainingPercent}% left`];
  if (typeof window.resetsAt === 'string') {
    const suffix = typeof window.resetsInSeconds === 'number' ? `, in ${formatSpan(window.resetsInSeconds)}` : '';
    parts.push(`resets ${localTime(window.resetsAt)}${suffix}`);
  }
  return `${label}: ${parts.join(' · ')}`;
}

/**
 * Render the status tool result as compact model-facing text.
 *
 * @param {Record<string, unknown>} status
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatStatusText(status) {
  if (status?.ok !== true) {
    const lines = [`Codex quota unavailable (${status?.code ?? 'UNKNOWN'})`, String(status?.message ?? '')];
    if (typeof status?.hint === 'string' && status.hint !== '') lines.push(`Hint: ${status.hint}`);
    if (typeof status?.stderrTail === 'string' && status.stderrTail !== '') {
      lines.push('', 'stderr tail:', status.stderrTail);
    }
    return lines.filter((line) => line !== '').join('\n');
  }
  const lines = [];
  lines.push(`Codex quota — ChatGPT ${status.planType ?? 'unknown'} — checked ${localTime(status.checkedAt)}`);
  lines.push(windowLine('5-hour window', status.windows?.fiveHour));
  lines.push(windowLine('Weekly window', status.windows?.weekly));
  const credits = status.credits;
  if (credits !== undefined) {
    const creditText = credits.unlimited ? 'unlimited' : credits.hasCredits ? (credits.balance ?? 'available') : 'none';
    lines.push(`Credits: ${creditText}`);
  }
  const reset = status.resetCredits;
  if (reset !== undefined) {
    const expiries = Array.isArray(reset.items)
      ? reset.items.map((item) => (typeof item.expiresAt === 'number' ? new Date(item.expiresAt * 1000).toLocaleDateString() : null)).filter(Boolean)
      : [];
    const suffix = expiries.length > 0 ? ` (expires ${expiries.join(', ')})` : '';
    lines.push(`Full-reset credits: ${reset.availableCount}${suffix}`);
  }
  const budget = status.budget;
  if (budget !== undefined) {
    const reasons = Array.isArray(budget.reasons) && budget.reasons.length > 0 ? ` — ${budget.reasons.join('; ')}` : '';
    lines.push(`Budget: ${budget.level}${reasons}`);
  }
  const models = Array.isArray(status.models) ? status.models : [];
  const defaultModel = models.find((model) => model.role === 'default');
  const roleLabels = {
    default: 'default',
    expensive: 'expensive; explicit only',
    fallback: 'fallback floor',
  };
  lines.push(`Models (default ${defaultModel?.id ?? status.policy?.defaultModel ?? 'unknown'}; floor ${status.policy?.minModel ?? 'unknown'}):`);
  if (models.length === 0) {
    lines.push('  (no models reported)');
  } else {
    for (const model of models) {
      const flags = [];
      if (roleLabels[model.role] !== undefined) flags.push(roleLabels[model.role]);
      if (model.configured === true) flags.push('configured, not listed by CLI');
      if (model.selectable === false) flags.push('not selectable');
      lines.push(`  - ${model.id}${flags.length > 0 ? ` (${flags.join('; ')})` : ''}: ${model.efforts.join('/')}`);
    }
  }
  if (defaultModel?.listed === false) {
    lines.push(`Note: ${defaultModel.id} is configured but not listed by this Codex CLI; codex exec can still accept it and may warn about missing model metadata.`);
  }
  const rec = status.recommendation;
  if (rec !== undefined) {
    lines.push('Recommended by budget:');
    for (const complexity of COMPLEXITIES) {
      if (rec[complexity] !== undefined) lines.push(`  ${complexity}: ${rec[complexity].model} / ${rec[complexity].effort}`);
    }
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

/**
 * Render the delegate tool result.
 *
 * @param {Record<string, unknown>} run result returned by the tool.
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function formatRunText(run) {
  if (run?.ok !== true) {
    const lines = [`Codex FAILED (${run?.code ?? 'UNKNOWN'})`];
    if (typeof run?.model === 'string') {
      lines.push(`${run.model} / ${run.effort ?? 'unknown'} · ${formatDuration(run.durationMs)} · exit ${String(run.exitCode ?? 'n/a')}`);
    }
    if (typeof run?.message === 'string' && run.message !== '') lines.push('', run.message);
    if (Array.isArray(run?.errors) && run.errors.length > 0) {
      lines.push('', 'Errors:', ...run.errors.map((error) => `- ${error}`));
    }
    if (typeof run?.stderrTail === 'string' && run.stderrTail !== '') {
      lines.push('', 'stderr tail:', run.stderrTail);
    }
    if (typeof run?.answer === 'string' && run.answer !== '') {
      lines.push('', 'Partial answer:', run.answer);
    }
    return lines.join('\n');
  }
  const lines = [`Codex OK — ${run.model} / ${run.effort} — ${formatDuration(run.durationMs)} — exit 0`];
  const usage = run.usage;
  if (usage !== null && usage !== undefined) {
    const parts = [
      `input ${usage.inputTokens}`,
      usage.cachedInputTokens > 0 ? `cached ${usage.cachedInputTokens}` : null,
      `output ${usage.outputTokens}`,
      usage.reasoningOutputTokens > 0 ? `reasoning ${usage.reasoningOutputTokens}` : null,
    ].filter(Boolean);
    lines.push(`Tokens: ${parts.join(' · ')}`);
  }
  if (typeof run.commandCount === 'number' && run.commandCount > 0) lines.push(`Commands run: ${run.commandCount}`);
  if (typeof run.fileChangeCount === 'number' && run.fileChangeCount > 0) lines.push(`File changes: ${run.fileChangeCount}`);
  const quota = run.quotaAfter;
  if (quota !== undefined && quota !== null) {
    const five = quota.fiveHour !== undefined ? `${quota.fiveHour.usedPercent}% used` : 'n/a';
    const week = quota.weekly !== undefined ? `${quota.weekly.usedPercent}% used` : 'n/a';
    lines.push(`Quota after: 5h ${five} · week ${week}${quota.budgetLevel ? ` · ${quota.budgetLevel}` : ''}`);
  }
  if (typeof run.threadId === 'string' && run.threadId !== '') lines.push(`Thread: ${run.threadId}`);
  if (typeof run.answer === 'string' && run.answer !== '') {
    lines.push('', '--- answer ---', run.answer);
  } else {
    lines.push('', '(Codex returned no textual answer)');
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

/** A refusal the tool layer can return as structured guidance instead of throwing. */
export class PolicyError extends Error {
  /**
   * @param {string} code stable machine code.
   * @param {string} message model-facing explanation.
   * @param {Record<string, unknown>} [details] optional structured context.
   */
  constructor(code, message, details) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'PolicyError';
    this.code = code;
    this.details = details ?? {};
  }
}

function clampNumber(value, fallback, min, max) {
  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) return fallback;
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.round(value)));
}

function pick(value, allowed, fallback) {
  return allowed.includes(value) ? value : fallback;
}

function text(value, fallback) {
  return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() !== '' ? value.trim() : fallback;
}

/**
 * Validate and normalize the raw Loader config.
 *
 * Unknown keys are ignored and out-of-range values are clamped so a bad patch
 * can never disable the quota guard or the model floor.
 *
 * @param {unknown} raw config from the Loader row.
 * @returns {typeof DEFAULT_CONFIG} a frozen, fully-populated config.
 */
export function resolveConfig(raw) {
  const input = raw !== null && typeof raw === 'object' ? raw : {};
  const minEffort = pick(input.minEffort, EFFORT_LADDER.slice(1), DEFAULT_CONFIG.minEffort);
  const defaultEffort = pick(input.defaultEffort, EFFORT_LADDER.slice(1), DEFAULT_CONFIG.defaultEffort);
  const cfg = {
    codexCommand: text(input.codexCommand, DEFAULT_CONFIG.codexCommand),
    codexHome: typeof input.codexHome === 'string' ? input.codexHome.trim() : DEFAULT_CONFIG.codexHome,
    statusCacheSeconds: clampNumber(input.statusCacheSeconds, DEFAULT_CONFIG.statusCacheSeconds, 1, 600),
    defaultSandbox: pick(input.defaultSandbox, ['read-only', 'workspace-write'], DEFAULT_CONFIG.defaultSandbox),
    ephemeral: typeof input.ephemeral === 'boolean' ? input.ephemeral : DEFAULT_CONFIG.ephemeral,
    maxTimeoutSeconds: clampNumber(input.maxTimeoutSeconds, DEFAULT_CONFIG.maxTimeoutSeconds, 30, 7200),
    maxOutputChars: clampNumber(input.maxOutputChars, DEFAULT_CONFIG.maxOutputChars, 1000, 60000),
    minModel: text(input.minModel, DEFAULT_CONFIG.minModel),
    defaultModel: text(input.defaultModel, DEFAULT_CONFIG.defaultModel),
    expensiveModel: text(input.expensiveModel, DEFAULT_CONFIG.expensiveModel),
    minEffort,
    defaultEffort: effortRank(defaultEffort) < effortRank(minEffort) ? minEffort : defaultEffort,
    reservePercent: clampNumber(input.reservePercent, DEFAULT_CONFIG.reservePercent, 1, 50),
    stopPercent: clampNumber(input.stopPercent, DEFAULT_CONFIG.stopPercent, 50, 100),
  };
  return Object.freeze(cfg);
}

/** @param {string} effort */
export function effortRank(effort) {
  return EFFORT_LADDER.indexOf(effort);
}

/**
 * Normalize `model/list` entries into catalog order.
 *
 * The app-server returns models in catalog priority order; `id` is the exact
 * `-m` value. Hidden entries are dropped here because they are not part of the
 * picker surface this bridge exposes.
 *
 * @param {unknown} rawModels the `data` field of `model/list`.
 * @returns {Array<{id:string,name:string,description:string,defaultEffort:string,efforts:string[],isDefault:boolean}>}
 */
export function normalizeModels(rawModels) {
  const list = Array.isArray(rawModels) ? rawModels : [];
  const models = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const entry of list) {
    if (entry === null || typeof entry !== 'object') continue;
    if (typeof entry.id !== 'string' || entry.id === '' || entry.hidden === true) continue;
    if (seen.has(entry.id)) continue;
    const rawEfforts = Array.isArray(entry.supportedReasoningEfforts) ? entry.supportedReasoningEfforts : [];
    const efforts = [];
    for (const item of rawEfforts) {
      const effort = typeof item === 'string' ? item : item?.reasoningEffort;
      if (typeof effort === 'string' && effortRank(effort) >= 0 && !efforts.includes(effort)) efforts.push(effort);
    }
    if (efforts.length === 0) continue;
    seen.add(entry.id);
    models.push({
      id: entry.id,
      name: typeof entry.displayName === 'string' && entry.displayName !== '' ? entry.displayName : entry.id,
      description: typeof entry.description === 'string' ? entry.description : '',
      defaultEffort: effortRank(entry.defaultReasoningEffort) >= 0 ? entry.defaultReasoningEffort : efforts[0],
      efforts,
      isDefault: entry.isDefault === true,
    });
  }
  return models;
}

function configuredModel(id, role, cfg) {
  return {
    id,
    name: id,
    description: 'configured model (not listed by the installed Codex CLI)',
    defaultEffort: cfg.defaultEffort,
    efforts: [...EFFORT_LADDER],
    isDefault: role === 'default',
    configured: true,
    listed: false,
    role,
    selectable: role !== 'other',
  };
}

/**
 * Build the deployment ladder: configured default, configured expensive model,
 * then the visible catalog. Only the three configured roles are selectable;
 * catalog models below the floor stay visible for context but cannot run.
 *
 * @param {ReturnType<typeof normalizeModels>} catalog
 * @param {typeof DEFAULT_CONFIG} cfg
 */
export function buildModelLadder(catalog, cfg) {
  const listed = new Map(catalog.map((model) => [model.id, model]));
  const ladder = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  const add = (id, role) => {
    if (typeof id !== 'string' || id === '' || seen.has(id)) return null;
    const entry = listed.get(id);
    const model = entry
      ? { ...entry, configured: false, listed: true, role, selectable: role !== 'other' }
      : configuredModel(id, role, cfg);
    seen.add(id);
    ladder.push(model);
    return model;
  };
  add(cfg.defaultModel, 'default');
  add(cfg.expensiveModel, 'expensive');
  for (const model of catalog) add(model.id, model.id === cfg.minModel ? 'fallback' : 'other');
  if (!seen.has(cfg.minModel)) add(cfg.minModel, 'fallback');
  for (const model of ladder) {
    if (model.id === cfg.minModel && model.role === 'other') {
      model.role = 'fallback';
      model.selectable = true;
    }
  }
  return ladder;
}

function windowOf(raw, now) {
  if (raw === null || raw === undefined || typeof raw !== 'object') return null;
  const usedValue = typeof raw.usedPercent === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw.usedPercent) ? raw.usedPercent : null;
  if (usedValue === null) return null;
  const usedPercent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, Math.round(usedValue)));
  const resetsAt = typeof raw.resetsAt === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw.resetsAt) ? raw.resetsAt : null;
  return {
    usedPercent,
    remainingPercent: 100 - usedPercent,
    windowMinutes: typeof raw.windowDurationMins === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw.windowDurationMins) ? raw.windowDurationMins : null,
    resetsAt,
    resetsInSeconds: resetsAt === null ? null : Math.max(0, resetsAt - Math.floor(now / 1000)),
  };
}

/**
 * Turn the account/rate-limit response into the bridge's quota view.
 *
 * @param {{
 *   rateLimits?: Record<string, unknown> | null,
 *   rateLimitResetCredits?: Record<string, unknown> | null,
 *   ordinaryUsageAllowed?: boolean | null,
 * }} response fields from `account/rateLimits/read`.
 * @param {number} now epoch milliseconds.
 */
export function readQuota(response, now) {
  const snapshot = response?.rateLimits && typeof response.rateLimits === 'object' ? response.rateLimits : {};
  const fiveHour = windowOf(snapshot.primary, now);
  const weekly = windowOf(snapshot.secondary, now);
  const creditsRaw = snapshot.credits && typeof snapshot.credits === 'object' ? snapshot.credits : null;
  const resetRaw = response?.rateLimitResetCredits && typeof response.rateLimitResetCredits === 'object' ? response.rateLimitResetCredits : null;
  const resetItems = Array.isArray(resetRaw?.credits)
    ? resetRaw.credits.slice(0, 5).map((item) => ({
      title: typeof item?.title === 'string' ? item.title : 'rate-limit reset',
      expiresAt: typeof item?.expiresAt === 'number' ? item.expiresAt : null,
    }))
    : [];
  return {
    fiveHour,
    weekly,
    ordinaryUsageAllowed: typeof response?.ordinaryUsageAllowed === 'boolean' ? response.ordinaryUsageAllowed : null,
    rateLimitReachedType: typeof snapshot.rateLimitReachedType === 'string' ? snapshot.rateLimitReachedType : null,
    credits: creditsRaw === null ? null : {
      hasCredits: creditsRaw.hasCredits === true,
      unlimited: creditsRaw.unlimited === true,
      balance: typeof creditsRaw.balance === 'string' ? creditsRaw.balance : null,
    },
    resetCredits: resetRaw === null ? null : {
      availableCount: typeof resetRaw.availableCount === 'number' ? resetRaw.availableCount : resetItems.length,
      items: resetItems,
    },
    planType: typeof snapshot.planType === 'string' ? snapshot.planType : null,
  };
}

/**
 * Classify the current quota.
 *
 * `normal`: both windows have more than the reserve left.
 * `reserve`: either window has `reservePercent` or less left; auto switches to
 *            the fallback model.
 * `blocked`: ordinary included usage is not allowed or a stop threshold was hit.
 * `unknown`: a window was missing; the bridge describes it and stays at the
 *            fallback recommendation.
 *
 * @param {ReturnType<typeof readQuota>} quota
 * @param {typeof DEFAULT_CONFIG} cfg
 * @returns {{level: string, reasons: string[], fiveHourUsed: number|null, weeklyUsed: number|null, fiveHourLeft: number|null, weeklyLeft: number|null}}
 */
export function computeBudget(quota, cfg) {
  const reasons = [];
  const five = quota.fiveHour?.usedPercent ?? null;
  const week = quota.weekly?.usedPercent ?? null;
  const fiveLeft = quota.fiveHour?.remainingPercent ?? null;
  const weekLeft = quota.weekly?.remainingPercent ?? null;

  if (quota.rateLimitReachedType !== null) {
    return { level: 'blocked', reasons: [`the backend reports ${quota.rateLimitReachedType}`], fiveHourUsed: five, weeklyUsed: week, fiveHourLeft: fiveLeft, weeklyLeft: weekLeft };
  }
  if (quota.ordinaryUsageAllowed === false) {
    return { level: 'blocked', reasons: ['ordinary included usage is not allowed right now'], fiveHourUsed: five, weeklyUsed: week, fiveHourLeft: fiveLeft, weeklyLeft: weekLeft };
  }
  if (five === null || week === null) {
    return { level: 'unknown', reasons: ['at least one quota window was missing from the backend snapshot'], fiveHourUsed: five, weeklyUsed: week, fiveHourLeft: fiveLeft, weeklyLeft: weekLeft };
  }
  if (five >= cfg.stopPercent) reasons.push(`5-hour window is ${five}% used (stop threshold ${cfg.stopPercent}%)`);
  if (week >= cfg.stopPercent) reasons.push(`weekly window is ${week}% used (stop threshold ${cfg.stopPercent}%)`);
  if (reasons.length > 0) {
    return { level: 'blocked', reasons, fiveHourUsed: five, weeklyUsed: week, fiveHourLeft: fiveLeft, weeklyLeft: weekLeft };
  }
  if (fiveLeft !== null && fiveLeft <= cfg.reservePercent) {
    reasons.push(`5-hour window has ${fiveLeft}% left (fallback at ${cfg.reservePercent}% or less)`);
  }
  if (weekLeft !== null && weekLeft <= cfg.reservePercent) {
    reasons.push(`weekly window has ${weekLeft}% left (fallback at ${cfg.reservePercent}% or less)`);
  }
  if (reasons.length > 0) {
    return { level: 'reserve', reasons, fiveHourUsed: five, weeklyUsed: week, fiveHourLeft: fiveLeft, weeklyLeft: weekLeft };
  }
  return {
    level: 'normal',
    reasons: [`5-hour window ${five}% used and weekly window ${week}% used are above the fallback reserve`],
    fiveHourUsed: five,
    weeklyUsed: week,
    fiveHourLeft: fiveLeft,
    weeklyLeft: weekLeft,
  };
}

function findRole(ladder, role, fallbackIndex) {
  return ladder.find((model) => model.role === role) ?? ladder[fallbackIndex] ?? null;
}

function supportedEffort(model, desired, cfg) {
  const minimum = Math.max(0, effortRank(cfg.minEffort));
  let best = null;
  for (const effort of model.efforts) {
    const rank = effortRank(effort);
    if (rank < minimum) continue;
    if (rank <= effortRank(desired)) {
      if (best === null || rank > effortRank(best)) best = effort;
    }
  }
  if (best !== null) return best;
  let weakest = null;
  for (const effort of model.efforts) {
    if (effortRank(effort) < minimum) continue;
    if (weakest === null || effortRank(effort) < effortRank(weakest)) weakest = effort;
  }
  return weakest ?? model.efforts[0];
}

/**
 * Recommend a model/effort pair per task bucket for the current budget.
 *
 * @param {ReturnType<typeof buildModelLadder>} ladder
 * @param {ReturnType<typeof computeBudget>} budget
 * @param {typeof DEFAULT_CONFIG} cfg
 * @returns {Record<string, {model: string, effort: string}>}
 */
export function recommend(ladder, budget, cfg) {
  const defaultModel = findRole(ladder, 'default', 0);
  const fallbackModel = findRole(ladder, 'fallback', ladder.length - 1);
  if (defaultModel === null || fallbackModel === null) {
    return Object.fromEntries(COMPLEXITIES.map((complexity) => [complexity, { model: cfg.minModel, effort: cfg.minEffort }]));
  }
  const normal = {
    simple: [defaultModel, cfg.defaultEffort],
    standard: [defaultModel, cfg.defaultEffort],
    hard: [defaultModel, cfg.defaultEffort],
    critical: [defaultModel, cfg.defaultEffort],
  };
  const conservative = {
    simple: [fallbackModel, 'medium'],
    standard: [fallbackModel, 'medium'],
    hard: [fallbackModel, 'medium'],
    critical: [fallbackModel, 'high'],
  };
  const table = budget.level === 'normal' ? normal : conservative;
  const result = {};
  for (const complexity of COMPLEXITIES) {
    const [model, effort] = table[complexity];
    result[complexity] = { model: model.id, effort: supportedEffort(model, effort, cfg) };
  }
  return result;
}

/**
 * Validate a caller's explicit or automatic model/effort choice.
 *
 * Explicit choices are never silently downgraded. Astra needs an explicit
 * `allowExpensiveModel`, and a blocked quota needs `allowLowQuota`; the model
 * floor and effort floor are absolute.
 *
 * @param {{
 *   ladder: ReturnType<typeof buildModelLadder>,
 *   budget: ReturnType<typeof computeBudget>,
 *   cfg: typeof DEFAULT_CONFIG,
 *   complexity: string,
 *   model: string,
 *   effort: string,
 *   allowLowQuota?: boolean,
 *   allowExpensiveModel?: boolean,
 * }} input
 * @returns {{model: string, effort: string, complexity: string, source: 'auto'|'explicit', budgetLevel: string, role: string}}
 */
export function resolveChoice(input) {
  const { ladder, budget, cfg } = input;
  const complexity = COMPLEXITIES.includes(input.complexity) ? input.complexity : 'standard';
  if (ladder.length === 0) throw new PolicyError('NO_MODELS', 'the Codex model ladder is empty; cannot choose a model');
  const autoModel = input.model === 'auto';
  const autoEffort = input.effort === 'auto';
  const rec = recommend(ladder, budget, cfg);
  const requestedModel = autoModel ? rec[complexity].model : input.model;
  const requestedEffort = autoEffort ? rec[complexity].effort : input.effort;
  const entry = ladder.find((model) => model.id === requestedModel);
  if (entry === undefined) {
    const selectable = ladder.filter((model) => model.selectable).map((model) => model.id);
    throw new PolicyError(
      'UNKNOWN_MODEL',
      `unknown model ${JSON.stringify(requestedModel)}; selectable models: ${selectable.join(', ')}`,
      { selectableModels: selectable },
    );
  }
  if (!entry.selectable) {
    const selectable = ladder.filter((model) => model.selectable).map((model) => model.id);
    throw new PolicyError(
      'MODEL_NOT_SELECTABLE',
      `${requestedModel} is below the floor or not a configured role; selectable models: ${selectable.join(', ')}`,
      { selectableModels: selectable },
    );
  }
  if (entry.role === 'expensive' && input.allowExpensiveModel !== true) {
    throw new PolicyError(
      'EXPENSIVE_MODEL_GUARD',
      `${requestedModel} consumes the shared ChatGPT quota much faster and is never selected automatically; set allow_expensive_model=true only when the user explicitly asks for it`,
      { model: requestedModel },
    );
  }
  if (budget.level === 'blocked' && input.allowLowQuota !== true) {
    throw new PolicyError(
      'QUOTA_BLOCKED',
      `Codex ordinary usage is blocked: ${budget.reasons.join('; ')}. Wait for the window to reset, or retry with allow_low_quota=true if you accept the risk.`,
      { level: budget.level, reasons: budget.reasons },
    );
  }
  const effort = typeof requestedEffort === 'string' ? requestedEffort : '';
  if (effortRank(effort) < 0) {
    throw new PolicyError('INVALID_EFFORT', `unknown reasoning effort ${JSON.stringify(effort)}`, { allowed: EFFORT_LADDER });
  }
  if (effortRank(effort) < effortRank(cfg.minEffort)) {
    throw new PolicyError(
      'BELOW_EFFORT_FLOOR',
      `${effort} is below this deployment's minimum reasoning effort ${cfg.minEffort}; use ${cfg.minEffort} or higher`,
      { minEffort: cfg.minEffort },
    );
  }
  if (!entry.efforts.includes(effort)) {
    throw new PolicyError(
      'EFFORT_UNSUPPORTED',
      `${entry.id} does not support reasoning effort ${effort}; supported: ${entry.efforts.join(', ')}`,
      { supported: entry.efforts },
    );
  }
  return {
    model: entry.id,
    effort,
    complexity,
    source: autoModel && autoEffort ? 'auto' : 'explicit',
    budgetLevel: budget.level,
    role: entry.role,
  };
}
